integrity.literature_scope: Primary arXiv texts for two baseline projector sources and mathematical indexed claims, with access limitations explicitly recorded.
integrity.mathematical_claim: exact all-rank affine projection norms, vertex-only norming, strict rank hierarchy and half-step asymptotics

scientific_limitations: Only regular cross-polytopes and uniform intrinsic probability over all faces of one rank; unequal rank weights or arbitrary polytopes not considered.
Only real affine L2 projection with L-infinity input/output norms; higher polynomial degrees not addressed.
Finite exact-rational checks corroborate the analytic proof and do not establish infinite statements.
Published-result indexing is incomplete; equivalent unindexed exact formulas remain a novelty risk.
title: Sharp affine-projection amplification across every cross-polytope face skeleton
